subject: Cemetery Archaeological Projects and Historic Property Reviews
overview: The Commission received updates on archaeological assessments at local cemeteries and reviewed a restoration proposal for the Unitarian Universalist Church. Members also discussed site plans for the new Fire Department headquarters and coordination with the Building Department on historic district permits.

items.title: 18 Wedgmere Road
items.summary: Tabled the case at the request of the owners while they determine plans for the property.

items.title: Wackling Court Demolition Review
items.summary: The Commission will withhold signing off on the demolition permit until the applicant provides evidence of a completed Section 106 review and contracts for archaeological monitoring.

items.title: Fire Department Headquarters Project Update
items.summary: The Commission discussed site plans for the new headquarters, including curb cuts and building orientation, and will seek formal architectural plans for courtesy review.

items.title: Unitarian Universalist Church CPA Application
items.summary: Joan Keene presented a proposal for a $85,000 restoration project involving shingle replacement and rot mediation at the 1894 structure. The Commission recommended engaging a preservation architect to distinguish the work from routine maintenance before issuing a letter of support for Community Preservation Act funding.

items.title: Properties Under Demolition Delay
items.summary: Updates were provided on ongoing mitigation discussions for properties on Main Street and Wareham Street.

items.title: Cemetery Assessment and Archaeological Projects
items.summary: RFPs have been issued for archaeological fieldwork at the former Cross Street Cemetery site, and headstone assessments are moving forward following the establishment of necessary city financial accounts.

items.title: Thomas Brooks Park and Brooks Estate Maintenance
items.summary: The Commission discussed the need for the Department of Public Works to maintain historic stone walls and planned a hybrid public meeting for September to present the park master plan.

items.title: Fulton Heights Survey and Future Survey Planning
items.summary: The Commission noted the completion of the Fulton Heights survey, covering 165 buildings, and discussed using city budget matching funds for a future neighborhood survey project.

items.title: Historic District Commission Permit Coordination
items.summary: Members discussed concerns regarding the lack of permit referrals to the Historic District Commission and proposed using GIS tagging to ensure historic properties are flagged during the building permit process.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes from June 2024.
